name: Ninh Binh
provinceNote: Ninh Binh province now also includes the former Ha Nam and Nam Dinh provinces.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A limestone valley south of Hanoi, where rowing boats glide through caves between rice fields and temples. Take a boat through the caves at Trang An, climb to the Mua Cave viewpoint, see the ancient capital at Hoa Lu, and try crispy rice with goat. One or two nights suits almost every traveller.
timeNeeded: One night, or two if you add Kim Sơn or Vân Long

seoTitle: Ninh Binh travel guide — Trang An boats, Hang Mua, Hoa Lu
seoDescription: Sit in a sampan at Tràng An, climb the Hang Múa stair over the rice, and walk the temples at Hoa Lư. The train from Hà Nội is kilometre 115. Cơm cháy and goat are the lunch.
intro: You sit low in a sampan on sông Sào Khê at Tràng An, rowed between limestone towers up to 200 m, caves opening off the channel and rice beyond the gunwale. The Tam Coc boat is a different ticket and a different page.

Hang Múa is the stair over the paddies. Hoa Lư, at xã Trường Yên, is the capital of the Đinh, the Tiền Lê, and the early Lý. Am Tiên is about 400 m from the east gate. Bái Đính is the pagoda hill in phường Tây Hoa Lư, about 20 km from the provincial centre.
Give the valley one night when the sampan, the stair, and the temples are the trip. Add a second night for Vân Long or the church at Kim Sơn. Phát Diệm, at xã Lưu Phương, was built from 1875 to 1898.

Cơm cháy is the crisp rice, and the goat plates are on the roads toward the sights. Breakfast is Phố ăn sáng Vân Giang. After dark, a lamp boat crosses hồ Kỳ Lân at Phố cổ Hoa Lư. The visit to the old street is free.
gettingAround: Ga Ninh Bình is the city stop. Southbound cells that stop are SE7 06:00–08:16, SE5 08:00–10:16, SE9 13:00–15:17, SE3 19:20–21:36, and SE1 21:45–00:03 the next day. SE10 has no Ninh Bình cell. Northbound, SE8 is 2 hours 21 minutes, SE6 is 2 hours 19 minutes, SE4 is 2 hours 22 minutes, and SE2 is 2 hours 18 minutes. The timetable puts the station at kilometre 115. It is also given as lý trình km 144+775 and as 115 km về phía Bắc.

From the station, the valley is a ride. Sleep near Tràng An when the sampan is the morning. Sleep by the station when the train is late. SE1 arrives at 00:03. The culture office at 29 Lê Đại Hành is not the station. The tourism office at 06 Tràng An is not the station.

eat: Cơm cháy is the crisp rice, and goat is on the roads toward the sights. Breakfast is Phố ăn sáng Vân Giang. The food guide lists the dishes and the doors on the 30 June 2025 provincial list.
interestsBody: Dining starts with cơm cháy and the goat roads. The food guide is the menu.
The sampan is sông Sào Khê at Tràng An. Hang Múa is the rice view. Vân Long is the other boat, in the wetland.
Hoa Lư is the old capital. The lamp boat on hồ Kỳ Lân is the evening. Bái Đính is the pagoda hill. Phát Diệm is the stone church at Kim Sơn.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: OCOP goods to carry home, Kim Sơn rượu, and the craft villages at Yên Ninh, Phong An, and Lai Thành.

blocks.heading: Craft villages and OCOP
paragraphs: Yên Ninh makes bún. Phong An is a food craft village. Lai Thành makes rượu. Kim Sơn’s jar wine sits with the province’s teas and honey among the OCOP goods.

cards.title: Kim Sơn rượu
cards.summary: Jar wine from Kim Sơn, with the rượu village at Lai Thành beside the noodle makers of Yên Ninh and the food village at Phong An.

interestGroups.title: Sao Khe boats
interestGroups.summary: The sampan through the towers, on sông Sào Khê.

blocks.heading: The sampan
paragraphs: You sit low in the boat and a local guide rows. An adult over 1.3 m pays 300,000 đồng, a child from 1 m to 1.3 m pays 150,000 đồng, and a child under 1 m is free, as of 30 March 2026. Đảo Khê Cốc is a separate ticket: 100,000 đồng and 50,000 đồng on those same lines.

The listed area is 6,226 ha with a 6,026 ha buffer and about 14,000 residents. A 2014 decision lists 6,172 ha and a 6,079 ha buffer. Another count is about 12,252 ha. A 2017 itinerary names 31 lakes and 48 caves.

cards.title: Tràng An
cards.summary: Sampans on sông Sào Khê. Adult 300,000 đồng. The Tam Coc boat is a different page.

interestGroups.title: Old capital
interestGroups.summary: The temples at Trường Yên, and the lamp boat after dark.

blocks.heading: Đền Đinh and đền Lê
paragraphs: Six kings are named: Đinh Tiên Hoàng, Đinh Toàn, Lê Đại Hành, Lê Trung Tông, Lê Long Đĩnh, and Lý Thái Tổ. An adult ticket is 20,000 đồng. A child aged 6 to 15 is 10,000 đồng, and so is a visitor aged 60 or over, and a disabled visitor.
Am Tiên is about 400 m from the east gate of đền Đinh, up 205 steps. The separate line is adult 100,000 đồng, child under 1.3 m 30,000 đồng.

blocks.heading: The lamp boat
paragraphs: Phố cổ Hoa Lư is free to visit. The hồ Kỳ Lân boat, with lamps, is adult 100,000 đồng and the same for a child over 1.29 m. A child under 1.29 m is 80,000 đồng. The VIP boat is 150,000 đồng, and 100,000 đồng for a child under 1.29 m.

cards.title: Hoa Lư
cards.summary: The tombs on núi Mã Yên and the two temples. Adult 20,000 đồng. Am Tiên is a separate line.

interestGroups.title: The pagoda hill
interestGroups.summary: Bái Đính, old foundation and the new hill.

blocks.heading: The hill
paragraphs: The old foundation is dated to Nguyễn Minh Không in 1136, and the new complex to an expansion from 2003. The area is more than 1,000 ha, and 107 ha on a 2017 itinerary. The reconstructed complex sits in the buffer.

Return electric cart: adult 150,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 100,000 đồng. The transfer package is 300,000 đồng and 210,000 đồng on those lines. A VIP cart with a guide on the cart is 4,000,000 đồng. A guide is 500,000 đồng a tour. A 2017 itinerary gives 500 arhat statues and bells of 36 tons and 27 tons. The bell is also captioned at 36 tons, 10 m high, diameter 5 m.

cards.title: Bái Đính
cards.summary: Lit towers at Tây Hoa Lư. The cart prices are on the desk. The walking fee is a separate line.

interestGroups.title: The rice view
interestGroups.summary: Climb Hang Múa for the paddies and the towers.

blocks.heading: The stair
paragraphs: The ticket is 150,000 đồng per person as of 30 March 2026. No child line is given. The river in the view is the Tam Coc side. That boat stays on the Tam Coc page.

cards.title: Hang Múa
cards.summary: Rice, karst, and the steps. 150,000 đồng per person.

interestGroups.title: The wetland
interestGroups.summary: Vân Long, the boat that is not the Sao Khe.

blocks.heading: The wetland
paragraphs: The address is xã Gia Vân, and also huyện Gia Viễn. It is dated 2019 as Vietnam’s 9th Ramsar site, and also called the 2nd Ramsar site of the Red River Delta. Site 2360 displayed 10 February 2017, an area of 2,736 ha, and the point 20°23′35″N 105°51′10″E. The wetland sits on the Pù Luông–Cúc Phương limestone.
Adult entry is 100,000 đồng. A child is 50,000 đồng, with no height on that line.

cards.title: Vân Long
cards.summary: Wetland water and limestone. Adult 100,000 đồng. The address is Gia Vân and also Gia Viễn.

interestGroups.title: The stone church
interestGroups.summary: Phát Diệm at Kim Sơn, a ride out from the karst.

blocks.heading: Kim Sơn
paragraphs: The complex was built from 1875 to 1898, at xã Lưu Phương, by Đức cha Phê rô Trần Lục. Kim Sơn’s reclamation is dated to Nguyễn Công Trứ in 1829. Nhà thờ Lớn has six rows of lim columns, counted as 52 columns and as 16 columns. It became a national relic in 1987.

cards.title: Phát Diệm
cards.summary: The stone front and the wooden nave at Kim Sơn.

faqs.a: Sleep in the Tràng An valley when the sampan is the morning. Sleep by Ga Ninh Bình when the train is late. SE1 arrives at 00:03.

faqs.q: How do you get there from Hanoi?
faqs.a: SE7 leaves Hà Nội at 06:00 and reaches Ninh Bình at 08:16, 2 hours 16 minutes. The timetable puts the station at kilometre 115, also given as lý trình km 144+775 and as 115 km về phía Bắc. Later southbound stops are SE5, SE9, SE3, and SE1. SE10 does not stop.

faqs.q: What does the Tràng An ticket cost?
faqs.a: As of 30 March 2026, an adult over 1.3 m pays 300,000 đồng, a child from 1 m to 1.3 m pays 150,000 đồng, and a child under 1 m is free. Đảo Khê Cốc is separate, at 100,000 đồng and 50,000 đồng.

faqs.q: When is the Hoa Lư festival?
faqs.a: The 8th through the 10th of lunar month 3, with a large festival every three years. The 10th is also given on its own.
